svm.note: Wrapped in CalibratedClassifierCV (sigmoid); broader C/gamma vs Slice 5 (M9 retune). Equal n_trials across families.

mlp.note: Replaces ExtraTrees (M9): distinct inductive bias (shallow MLP) vs bagged trees; avoids near-duplicate RF/ExtraTrees pair.

frank_hall_rf.note: Frank–Hall ordinal reduction with RF binary thresholds (M8).

frank_hall_logistic.note: Frank–Hall ordinal reduction with logistic binary thresholds (M8).

conformal.selection_note: M11: prefer Mondrian when grade-3 has ≥5 calib samples (class-conditional); else coverage closest to 1−α with Mondrian tie-break. Prediction sets forced contiguous on the ordinal grade scale.

protocol_note: selection_biased: argmax pooled outer-OOF QWK over model×imputer. nested_unbiased: per outer fold pick model×imputer by inner QWK only. production (M10): model×imputer with best mean inner_qwk across outer folds (not mode-of-winners); fold-winner instability reported separately. pooled_oof vs mean_fold are both reported for every candidate. Decoding (M8): argmax and median-of-distribution QWK compared on OOF.

selection_biased.note: Optimistic: model×imputer chosen using the same outer OOF scores reported.

nested_unbiased.note: Unbiased OOF: per outer fold pick by inner QWK. Production artefact uses best mean inner_qwk (M10), not mode-of-winners.

fusion_protocol: cross_fit_grouped_folds: ECE/Brier/mean_R_final from held-out fold scores; production fusion.joblib fitted on all OOF for serving

fusion_feature_report.note: Locked Item 9: simplest set whose risk-coverage area tied best (paired CI vs best contains 0); A ≺ B ≺ C ≺ D.

risk_coverage_comparison.note: Locked set A uses r_model only; R_final is a calibrated monotone map of max-prob-like confidence. Near-zero Δ is expected collapse, not proof agents add ranking signal.
